create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance to track diagnostic data across training iterations
configure_output_file: configure the Logger output file path to write tab-separated diagnostic logs
log_tabular_key_value: log a key-value diagnostic pair to the Logger current row for each iteration
print_tabular_diagnostics: print all current iteration diagnostics in a formatted table to stdout
dump_tabular_to_file: dump all current iteration diagnostics as tab-separated values to the output file
